**Entry escalated (EXC-001)**

There's no invoice, credit note, contract change, or email behind it, and all three DE customers are fully invoiced and collected for Q1. At the March rate it's USD 10,998.90, above the USD 10k posting limit, with no approval requested. I flagged it rather than reversing, per your instruction to escalate what can't be substantiated; my recommendation is reversal unless support and approval are produced before lock.

**Everything else checked out** — all other March vendor bills and customer invoices have March service periods, nothing leaked from February, and no post-month-end March-service bills need accruing. DE "AP cutoff review" is marked complete.
